reason: Hand-DMing is wearing me out, so I get the pitch, but I've seen a hundred AI DM tools and they all write the same stiff opener. Zero published results and 7 seats taken doesn't tell me it works, and I'm not putting my real Instagram on the line for that.
objection: AI-written DMs sound robotic and prospects can tell, and there's not a single customer result to show me otherwise. If the extension gets my account flagged, I lose my main lead channel for a tool that has no proof.
would_change_my_mind: Real screenshots or a short video of actual DMs it wrote for agency-type prospects with real reply and booked-call numbers from an agency owner like me, or a free trial with no card where I can see 10 drafts on my own niche first.
